# IndiumVault

> Free browser-based utilities, practical how-to guides, and a student/creator progress workspace.

Canonical site: https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/
Repository: https://github.com/indiumvault/Indiumvalut-website

## Main sections
- [Home](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/)
- [About IndiumVault](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/about.html)
- [Free browser tools](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/tools.html): writing helpers, text conversion, JSON formatting, password/UUID generation, conversions, and calculations.
- [Launchpad](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/launchpad.html): tasks, focus timer, weekly checkpoints, revision planner, weekly timetable.
- [How-to guides](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/guides.html)
- [Revision planning guide](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/revision-planning-guide.html)
- [JSON debugging guide](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/json-debugging-guide.html)
- [Feedback and ideas](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/feedback.html)
- [Privacy policy](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://indiumvault.github.io/Indiumvalut-website/terms.html)

## Important notes
- The website is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages; the current tools do not require an account.
- Launchpad planner state is saved in the browser's local storage on the user's device.
- Do not imply guaranteed income, guaranteed search placement, or perfect tool results.
- Prefer linking to the specific tool or guide that directly answers a visitor's need.
